summary: New Pacific Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K on July 16, 2026, reporting an updated preliminary economic assessment (PEA) for its Carangas project in Bolivia. The PEA outlines post-tax NPV (5%) of $2.65 billion and IRR of 35.9% at base-case metal prices, projecting 339 million ounces of silver equivalent production over a 19-year mine life. Initial capital costs are $644.5 million with a 2.4-year payback. This filing is a routine technical update for a mineral project, not a special-situation event. It involves no transaction, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no deal terms. It is a standard operational disclosure for a mining company.
